$comment: Derived from Voltur792/astra-music@v2.0.0. Digests are of the bytes the bot downloaded and the attestation covers. Ownership proved by: unrecorded.

dom_access.reason: Shows the music queue directly below Astra's music widget, above neighboring cards, without changing widget size

send_chat_message.reason: Optional radio presenter: announces songs using Astra's configured personality, model and voice only when enabled by the user

subscribe_events.reason: Temporarily lower the music player's volume while Astra listens or speaks, including optional radio announcements, then restore it
